detections.diagnosis: Cracked front tempered glass, frame distortion, or structural cell fracture.
detections.recommended_action: Schedule panel replacement. Seal damaged glass if rain is forecast to prevent water ingress and ground faults.
detections.estimated_impact: Moisture penetration, ground fault circuit trips, permanent cell destruction.

maintenance_info.diagnosis: Cracked front tempered glass, frame distortion, or structural cell fracture.
maintenance_info.recommended_action: Schedule panel replacement. Seal damaged glass if rain is forecast to prevent water ingress and ground faults.
sop: 1. Verify inverter isolation and ground-fault protection status.
2. Apply weatherproof transparent silicone patch if moisture ingress is imminent.
3. Disconnect MC4 connectors using rated disconnect tool.
4. Replace damaged module with matched electrical characteristics panel.
